tools.name: functions.exec
tools.description: Run JavaScript code to orchestrate/compose tool calls

parameters.name: FREEFORM
parameters.description: JavaScript source; may start with an exec pragma. Nested tools are available through the tools namespace.

tools.name: functions.wait
tools.description: Waits on a yielded `exec` cell and returns new output or completion.

parameters.name: cell_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the running `exec` cell.

parameters.name: max_tokens
parameters.description: Output token budget. Defaults to 10000 tokens.

parameters.name: terminate
parameters.description: True stops the running cell; false or omitted waits for output.

parameters.name: yield_time_ms
parameters.description: Wait before yielding more output. Defaults to 10000 ms.

tools.name: functions.request_user_input
tools.description: Request user input for one to three short questions and wait for the response. This tool is only available in Plan mode.

parameters.name: questions
parameters.description: Questions to show the user. Prefer 1 and do not exceed 3.

tools.name: functions.request_user_input_async
tools.description: Ask the user one or more questions during ongoing work. Use this tool only to request missing information, preferences, constraints, clarification, or approval.

parameters.name: questions
parameters.description: One or more self-contained questions to present together, in display order.

tools.name: clock.sleep
tools.description: Pause execution for a specified duration. The sleep ends early when new input arrives for the active turn. Returns the elapsed wall-clock time.

parameters.name: duration_ms
parameters.description: How long to sleep in milliseconds. Must be between 1 and 43200000.

tools.name: collaboration.spawn_agent
tools.description: Spawn a sub-agent to handle a subtask. The new agent will have the same tools as you and the ability to spawn its own subagents.

parameters.name: fork_turns
parameters.description: Parent history to inherit. Defaults to `all`.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Initial plain-text task for the new agent.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model override.

parameters.name: reasoning_effort
parameters.description: Reasoning effort override.

parameters.name: task_name
parameters.description: Task name for the new agent.

tools.name: collaboration.followup_task
tools.description: Send a follow-up task to an existing non-root target agent and trigger a turn if it is idle.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Message text to send to the target agent.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Agent id or canonical task name to send the task to.

tools.name: collaboration.interrupt_agent
tools.description: Interrupt an agent's current turn, if any, and return its previous status. The agent remains available for follow-up tasks.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Agent id or canonical task name to interrupt.

tools.name: collaboration.list_agents
tools.description: List live agents in the current root thread tree. Optionally filter by task-path prefix.

parameters.name: path_prefix
parameters.description: Task-path prefix filter without a trailing slash. Omit to list all live agents.

tools.name: collaboration.send_message
tools.description: Send a message to an existing agent. Does not trigger a turn.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Message text to queue on the target agent.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Relative or canonical task name.

tools.name: collaboration.wait_agent
tools.description: Wait for a mailbox update from any live agent, including queued messages and final-status notifications.

parameters.name: timeout_ms
parameters.description: Timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000, min 10000, max 3600000.

parameters.name: search_query
parameters.description: Internet search queries.

parameters.name: open
parameters.description: Open links or URLs.

parameters.name: click
parameters.description: Open links from previously opened pages.

parameters.name: find
parameters.description: Find text patterns in pages.

parameters.name: image_query
parameters.description: Search for images.

parameters.name: finance

parameters.name: weather

parameters.name: sports

parameters.name: time
